name: TajMahal
caption: Built in the 17th century by Mughal Emperor Shah Jahan as a mausoleum for his beloved wife, Mumtaz Mahal. It is a masterpiece of white marble architecture

name: Chambord
caption: A grand 16th-century French Renaissance castle featuring a distinct blend of traditional French medieval forms and classical Renaissance structures.

name: Safdarjung
caption: An imposing garden mausoleum built in 1754 in the late Mughal style for Nawab Safdarjung, featuring red sandstone and marble domes

name: Waddesdon
caption: A magnificent country house built in the Neo-Renaissance style of a French château in the late 19th century by Baron Ferdinand de Rothschild

name: Colosseo
caption: Completed in 80 AD, this massive stone amphitheater held grand gladiator battles and drama performances in the heart of the Roman Empire.
